newsitem.title: USA: Sci to acquire Group Tech plants.
newsitem.headline: Sci to acquire Group Tech plants.

text.p: SCI Systems Inc said Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to purchase the Mexican and Brazilian operations of Group Technologies Corp as well as certain net assets consigned to the Mexican unit.
Terms of the agreement and the purchase price were not disclosed.
"The acquisition of GTC Brazil will facilitate SCI's entry into the Brazilian market with facilities, management and customers," said SCI president A. Eugene Sapp.
He added, "The acquisition of GTC Mexico will serve as a strategic element of SCI's Mexican growth initiatives."

Jeffrey T. Gill, chairman of Group Technologies said the proceeds from the sale would enable Group Technologies to repay the balance of its debt and to concentrate the company's resources on engineering, federal systems and its contract manufacturing business.
In a joint statement, the companies said they expect to enter into a definitive agreement and close the sale of the two plants by the end of June.
SCI Systems Inc is a diversified electronics manufacturer, while Group Technologies provides manufacturing, engineering and testing services to manufacturers of electronic products.
